statement: At fixed original weighted-homeostasis motivation, capped temporally persistent exploration improves balanced learned behavior over stepwise epsilon-greedy within 20000 ecology-v2 training steps.
rationale: The motivation pilot learned little foraging and p4 traded safety for temperature. This does not prove exploration is the cause. Live's globally consistent movement directions make persistent random trajectories a concrete alternative to local dithering. Keep reward, discount, optimizer, replay, network, training steps and evaluation fixed.
falsification: No full-study promotion unless worst behavioral criterion ratio improves at least 10% in two of three paired training seeds, hunger.mean decreases at least .05 in two seeds, and aggregate temperature MAE, proximity and contact proxy each worsen at most 10%. All fixed criteria and per-seed curves must be reported. Food acquisition during frozen greedy evaluation, rather than exploratory random movement alone, must improve.

sources.title: Temporally-Extended epsilon-Greedy Exploration
sources.versionRead: arXiv v1, 2020-06-02; conference version ICLR 2021 identified separately
sources.sectionsRead: Sections 4, 4.1, 4.2; section 6 Generality and Limitations; Appendix B.1 pseudo-code, B.3 implementation details
sources.mechanism: Repeat a uniformly selected exploratory primitive action for a duration sampled from a distribution, preserving single-step greedy exploitation. Capped zeta(2) supports mostly short moves and occasional long consistent motion.
sources.limitations: Source experiments do not establish effectiveness in Live. We cap duration at32 rather than Atari100 or10000; interrupt a repeat when the action is illegal or conditions change. We additionally correct start probability for nominal primitive-step exploration occupancy. This is an adaptation, not a replication. Walls and changing epsilon break exact stationary occupancy matching; export actual exploration counts and illegal terminations. Persistent direction may be harmful near moving threats.

protocol.motivation: Original weighted-homeostasis; equivalent to power p1 established separately. No p4 combination.
protocol.controls: Duration1 paired control, random/untrained/initial frozen. Compare duration1 hashes/metrics with prior pilot p1 as a technical regression check; repetitions are not independent scientific evidence.
protocol.checkpointRule: Only final20000-step policy for decision; show curves0/10000/20000 without selecting best.
protocol.primary: Per training seed max of evaluation-world averaged six metric/threshold ratios from unchanged baseline criteria.
protocol.exploration: P(duration=n) proportional to n^-2 for n=1..32. If mean duration L and desired epsilon e, start probability=e/(L-e*(L-1)); nominal stationary primitive-step fraction=e when repeats complete. Duration1 takes the exact old RNG path. Train after each primitive transition as before; frozen inference never repeats exploratory actions.
protocol.diagnostics: Final checkpoint InferenceState.exploration records Choices, ExploratoryActions, Bursts, IllegalTerminations, MeanDuration. These are training diagnostics, not optimizer/RNG continuation state. Source and imported inference both restore observation weights; diagnostics need not resume.
